description: FREE. Live Hyperliquid funding rates and open interest for the whole book, as a dashboard snapshot: per-exchange market rows plus aggregate total OI, median funding and OI-weighted funding (8h and APR). Refreshed every 2 minutes from a local snapshot. Poll this every 2 minutes to log it yourself; not counted against the 20/day free-teaser cap. More exchanges coming. perp_funding ($0.01) is the live paid book; buy_dataset live_perps_snapshot ($0.02) is the downloadable file. Returns JSON with exchanges[], aggregate (total OI, median and OI-weighted 8h/APR funding), data_as_of, and a how_to_log object.
name: free_perps_dashboard
title: Live funding and open-interest dashboard (free)
